summary: An interactive story game about hardware and equipments left on the Moon and Mars as per the challenge. Our game tells the story, the challenges and the purpose of these equipments with a fun little space shooter game as the side! Our game teaches the importance of these artifacts and hence it's own importance. Made with our five loving hearts :)
details:
Our project works as an interactive, 2D browser-based educational game where players can explore the Moon and Mars through a main menu. Upon selecting a location, players are introduced to a library of space exploration rovers and equipment, where they can choose different explorers and unlock their stories. Each story combines scientific information, mission history and interactive gameplay, allowing players to learn about the purpose and discoveries of these machines in an entertaining way. Some gameplay elements include arcade-style challenges, such as shooting down incoming comets, to make the learning experience more engaging.

The project benefits users by making space science more accessible, encouraging curiosity and improving their understanding of space exploration. Its intended impact is to raise awareness of the scientific importance of human-made objects left on other celestial bodies and inspire greater interest in science, technology and space exploration.

The project is being developed using Scratch, a block-based programming platform, with a computer and web browser as the main development tools. Its creativity comes from combining educational content with cinematic storytelling, interactive exploration and game mechanics rather than simply presenting facts through text or slides.

Throughout development, our team considered factors such as educational value, scientific accuracy, user engagement, accessibility, visual design and ease of navigation. We aim to create an experience that is both informative and enjoyable, allowing players to learn while feeling as though they are part of a space exploration mission.
